common.offlineSubmit: You're offline. Connect to the internet to send this.

onboarding.slide1Body: Attendance, results, homework, notices and fees: the same information the school keeps, on your phone.
onboarding.slide2Body: Parents follow each of their children. Students hand in work. Teachers mark attendance and enter marks.
onboarding.slide3Body: You see only what the school lets you see. Your sign-in stays in your phone's secure storage.

auth.signInSubtitle: Use the username and password your school gave you.
auth.identifierHint: Students: your admission number. Parents: p. followed by your child's admission number.
auth.schoolCodeHint: Only if your school asked you to enter one.
auth.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask your school office to reset it. They'll give you a temporary one.
auth.notConfigured: This app has no school server set. It must be rebuilt with EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL.
auth.restoreFailed: We couldn't reach the server to restore your session.
auth.restoreStillSignedIn: You are still signed in. Check your connection and try again.
auth.noAccessTitle: This account can't use the app
auth.noAccessBody: Your account has no role the app recognises. Ask your school office.

password.forcedBody: Your school gave you a temporary password. Choose a new one to continue.
password.changeBody: After changing it you'll be signed out everywhere, including the web, and sign in again.
password.rules: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number.
password.same: Choose a password different from the current one
password.changedSignIn: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.

profile.signOutConfirm: Sign out of this phone? The school's system also signs you out on the web.
